scope: Primary Claude protocol references and inspected native67 source interpretation. This is not compilation, execution, model availability, live-provider or cryptographic-verification evidence.

sources.interpretation: Content indexes identify final block order. Tool input arrives as partial JSON strings and completes as an object. Thinking text and signature use distinct deltas; the signature arrives before that block closes. Native replay therefore retains ordered blocks and accepted raw input tokens rather than reconstructing history from visible text alone.

Thinking/redacted blocks must remain unchanged during tool continuation. Signature and redacted data fields are opaque provider material; retaining them is different from validating their authenticity. The native checkpoint checks structure and DTO consistency without interpreting, decrypting or locally verifying those fields.

The observed legacy page delegates response, streaming, preservation and encryption mechanics to the Thinking overview. No blanket HTTP redirect, model support or native thinking-configuration support is inferred.

nativeSourceInterpretation.status: Implementation in progress; native67 compilation and acceptance pending

receipt.content_json: JSON string containing a reconstructed ordered content array; raw HTTP/SSE framing is not retained
receipt.dtoMatch: Concatenated text equals visible assistant content. Ordered tool IDs, names and exact raw argument strings equal the native tool_calls. Foreign, empty and mismatched receipts fail before outgoing transport.

finishPairs.tool_use: tool_calls with one or more matched calls
finishPairs.max_tokens: length with no executable or replayable tool calls

nativeSourceInterpretation.visibility: Only text blocks produce ordinary assistant content/model.text. Thinking, signatures and redacted data remain provider continuation material.
nativeSourceInterpretation.opaqueHandling: Nonempty signature/data strings are retained unchanged as decoded values. No base64 interpretation, decryption or local cryptographic verification; no authenticity, account/model compatibility or live replay acceptance inferred.
nativeSourceInterpretation.toolArguments: Preserve accepted original input JSON token slices and escaped keys through content_json string persistence and outgoing serialization; object/depth/duplicate checks still apply.
nativeSourceInterpretation.boundsAre: Native implementation byte limits, not provider API limits; currently inspected source, pending compiled acceptance

bounds.serializedReceiptNote: Escaping and envelope overhead count; source content can reach the serialized limit earlier
bounds.signatureAndRedactedDataRequire: Nonempty valid UTF-8 strings with no NUL; empty thinking text is allowed with a nonempty supplied signature
bounds.toolNameGrammar: ASCII letters, digits, underscore and hyphen
